cache.clear_description: Frees the cached downloads. Files are re-fetched from the network the next time they're needed.

settings.curseforge_key_hint: CurseForge only answers requests carrying a key, so it is offered as a source once you set one. Get yours from console.curseforge.com.
settings.default_memory_hint: Instances and servers can override this individually.

java.uninstall_description: {name} will be removed. Entries that need it reinstall it on the next start.

settings.keep_open: Keep the launcher open while a game runs

modpack.default_excludes_hint: Off, a pack is trusted exactly as published — client mods included.
modpack.hint: Packs routinely declare client-only mods as server-compatible. Hestia holds those back when installing a pack on a server.
modpack.overrides_exclusions_hint: Config and world files the pack ships that should not be written. ? one character, * a run within one folder, ** a run across folders.
modpack.title: Modpacks

news.enabled_description: Hestia checks its announcement feed every few hours. Turn this off and it makes no such request.

settings.subtitle: Launcher, runtimes and daemon

adopt.description: Moves the instance’s existing folder contents into the shared store and links them. The instance must be stopped.

sync.description: Files are copied and merged at each launch; folders are linked into one shared store.
sync.enabled_description: Off, every instance keeps its own settings, configs and worlds. Folders already shared stay shared.
